titulo: Almost Nobody Laughs at Jokes — 1,200 Recordings Say So
descripcion: A neuroscientist went out with a notebook and logged twelve hundred episodes of real laughter in malls and on sidewalks, along with the exact line that came before each one. Only 10 to 20% were remotely joke-like. This episode covers what laughter actually is (a social signal, not a review of your content), the two findings that give it away, why your ear can tell a fake laugh from a real one across twenty-four different societies, and what to do instead of writing punchlines. Ends with the warning that runs against the usual advice.
